instruction: Set up a workflow to resize all images in the 'Desktop/Images' folder to a width of 600 pixels while maintaining the aspect ratio and saves them back in the same folder.
evaluator: S=$(find "$HOME/Pictures/To Convert" -name '*.png' -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l); C=$(find "$HOME/Pictures/Converted" -name '*.jpg' -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l); [ $S -gt 0 ] && [ $C -ge $S ] && echo True || echo False
